thread:
Alex: Heads up — planning the base-image rebase + sidecar audit-bridge swap this Friday 03:00 UTC. Need RBAC delegations + KMS signer handoff checklist.
Maria: ACK. Do we have the list of service accounts that need new roles?
Alex: current plan: image-rebuilder SA (rebuilds namespace) gets 'image-builder' role; audit-bridge SA gets 'log-forwarder' + 'attestor' roles. Also rotate cosign signer to ephemeral KMS-protected key.
Tara: quick Q — will the sidecar change require mounting host /var/log or are we using forwarder agent?
Alex: using forwarder agent (sidecar) so no host mount. We'll need read access to pod logs and permission to create ephemeral attestations.
Jonathan: for RBAC, prefer ClusterRoleBinding for the rebuild orchestrator, but keep audit-bridge namespaced. Example patch I'm planning to apply:
```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: audit-bridge-forwarder-binding
  namespace: rebuilds
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: audit-bridge
  namespace: rebuilds
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: log-forwarder
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
```
Maria: add a condition in the admission webhook to forbid image:latest for the rebuild jobs.
Alex: yes — admission change is in the playbook. Also need to update the signing pipeline: cosign -> KMS sign request via signer-proxy.
security-oncall: @Alex @Maria make sure the KMS key rotation window is set to allow a 30m overlap. If the ephemeral signer flips mid-run, we should fallback to old key for 1 hour.
sre-bot: CI check for 'rebase-playbook' passed: unit tests OK, e2e mocks failing on attestation flow (error: 401 from signer-proxy).
Tara: 401 from signer-proxy usually means SA doesn't have kms.decrypt on the signer KMS key. Confirming needed policy: projects/*/locations/*/keyRings/*/cryptoKeys/*/cryptoKeyVersions/* : roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter for signer SA.
Jonathan: I will send a policy request to iam-automation to bind roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter to signer-proxy-sa in the rebuilds namespace.
Alex: checklist so far:
- RBAC bindings (image-rebuilder, audit-bridge, signer-proxy)
- Admission webhook update to block image:latest
- KMS role binding + rotation overlap policy
- Cosign config update (kms://... key ref)
- Observability: enable audit-bridge traces + export to seclog project
- Rollback plan: canary build w/ old sidecar + deny new attestation enforcement
Maria: For audit logs — we should TTL them 90 days in the seclog project but keep a 365-day index for incidents. Set an alert if forwarding latency > 30s.
security-oncall: On incident runbook, add a step: if signer-proxy returns 5xx, switch to read-only redeploy (no new signings) and open PagerDuty.
Tara: small nit — the sidecar image tag will change to rbase-2026-03-20. Make sure image-scanning policy runs in CI pre-cutover.
Alex: good call. Also we'll add a canary that only signs non-production images for the first 2 hours.
Jonathan: pushing RBAC PR to git (https://git.internal/redwood/rebuilds/pulls/225). Please review.
Maria: reviewing now, left a comment re: role scope (namespace vs cluster).
Alex: final ask before the window — someone from security-oncall to be present at 03:00 UTC for handoff and post-cutover audit check.
security-oncall: I'll be there. Will run these checks after deploy:
- verify audit-bridge pods in running state
- confirm cosign signatures for canary image (cosign verify --key <kms://...>)
- check stackdriver/seclog for new attestation entries
Alex: awesome. After cutover, we'll run the post-rebase smoke: start 5 small rebuild jobs, ensure logs show forwarder ack and cosign signatures present.
Tara: I'll prepare the smoke script and an automated rollback job.
Alex: thanks all — tagging playbook link /docs/rebase-sidecar-playbook.md and scheduling calendar invite. :thumbsup:
